page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.32xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance within the Enhanced server family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. The virtual machine provides 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors clocked at 2.7 GHz. It is paired with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is not present, with zero GPUs allocated to the instance.

In terms of I/O resources, the ecs.c7nex.32xlarge does not include local storage, requiring network-attached cloud storage volumes for all non-volatile disk requirements. Network connectivity is a primary differentiator for this instance class, delivering a baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating assigned networking infrastructure for public routing.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio and high network throughput make this instance suitable for highly parallel compute-intensive tasks, batch data processing, network traffic distribution, and distributed scientific computing. Without bundled local storage, workloads requiring low-latency scratch disk space face potential I/O latency tradeoffs over the network. In terms of cost efficiency, the dense dedicated core count and extensive networking throughput provide consolidated resource utility for large-scale clustered workloads without paying for unneeded memory capacity or GPU components.
